adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js`, `setupController` now calls `model.findMembers();` without returning/awaiting the promise. Previously, `afterModel` returned `model.findMembers().then(...)`, so a rejection would propagate through the route's promise chain and be handled by Ember's error-substate mechanisms. With the new fire-and-forget call, a failed `/groups/:name/members.json` request (see `Discourse.Group#findMembers` uses `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` with no local error handling) won't be surfaced via route error handling and will leave `members`/pagination state unset or stale.
